description: Tool to retrieve balance settings for a Stripe account. Use when you need to fetch configuration options for customizing account balances and payout settings for a connected account or the authenticated account.

stripe_account.description: The connected account ID for which to retrieve balance settings. If not provided, retrieves settings for the authenticated account.
stripe_account.title: Stripe Account

name: get_balance_settings

debit_negative_balances.description: A Boolean indicating if Stripe should try to reclaim negative balances from an attached bank account.
debit_negative_balances.title: Debit Negative Balances

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'balance_settings' for balance settings objects.
object.title: Object

monthly_payout_days.description: Payout day(s) of month (1-31). Values 29-31 resolve to month-end. Visible only when interval is 'monthly'.
monthly_payout_days.title: Monthly Payout Days

weekly_payout_days.description: Days of week for payouts. Possible values: 'monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday'. Visible only when interval is 'weekly'.
weekly_payout_days.title: Weekly Payout Days

minimum_balance_by_currency.description: Currency-keyed object specifying minimum retained balances before automatic payouts trigger. Example: {'usd': 1500, 'cad': 8000}.
minimum_balance_by_currency.title: Minimum Balance By Currency

delay_days.description: Number of days before funds become available.
delay_days.title: Delay Days
